title: Junior Service Desk Engineer
description: Job Family : User Support (India) Travel Required : None Clearance Required : None Junior Service Desk Engineer What You Will Do: Work as a Junior Service Desk / Helpdesk / Desktop Support Engineer, providing first-level IT support. Escalate or route complex issues to next-level IT support teams following standard procedures. Maintain proper documentation of incidents, solutions, and user interactions. Customer-service mindset: Friendly, approachable, patient, and genuinely interested in helping customers. Willingness to communicate and engage: Comfortable speaking with users and handling customer-facing interactions across calls, chats, and tickets. Willingness to learn: Demonstrates the ability and interest to learn new technologies, processes, tools, and troubleshooting methods. Positive attitude and ownership: Shows enthusiasm for helping customers and takes responsibility for progressing issues toward resolution. Technical aptitude: Possesses a reasonable technical foundation and aptitude. Technical skills can be further developed through training, so technical depth alone should not be the primary deciding factor. The overall expectation is to identify candidates who have the right customer-service attitude, communication ability, and willingness to learn, supported by a reasonable technical foundation. description: Job description: Role : Gen AI Engineer Job Description: Collect and prepare data for training and evaluating multimodal foundation models. Build and deploy AI applications on cloud platforms – any hyperscaler Azure, GCP or AWS. Integrate AI models with our company's data to enhance and augment existing applications. Knowledge of advanced programming like Python, and especially AI-centric libraries like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras. This includes the ability to implement and manipulate complex algorithms fundamental to developing generative AI models. Knowledge of Natural language processing (NLP) for text generation projects like text parsing, sentiment analysis, and the use of transformers like GPT (generative pre-trained transformer) models. Experience in Data management, including data pre-processing, augmentation, and generation of synthetic data. This involves cleaning, labeling, and augmenting data to train and improve AI models. Experience in developing and deploying AI models in production environments. Knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding of containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes for deploying , managing and scaling AI solutions Should be able to bring new ideas and innovative solutions to our clients #Position will close on 24th November Pay: From ₹1,400,000.00 per year Experience: Gen AI: 2 years (Preferred) IT: 4 years (Required) Location: Hyderabad, Telangana (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana
